queries_run: Seagate STX manufacturing location geopolitical risk 2026
Seagate supply chain single point of failure hard disk drive
Seagate STX Taiwan OR China OR geopolitical exposure 2026
hard disk drive supply chain concentration risk 2026

findings.claim: Seagate 10-K (FY ended 2026-07-03) states: 'Component manufacturing, subassembly and final test and assembly operations are performed at facilities in China, Malaysia, Northern Ireland, Singapore, Thailand and the United States.' The excerpt read gives no per-site percentage split.
findings.source: Seagate Technology Holdings plc Form 10-K FY2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001137789/000113778926000159/stx-20260703.htm

findings.claim: Seagate 10-K risk-factor language: 'Shortages or delays in the receipt of, or cost increases in, critical components, equipment or raw materials necessary to manufacture our products, as well as reliance on single-source suppliers, have in the past and may in the future affect our production.' Also: 'Certain components and raw materials are available from a limited number of suppliers.'
findings.source: Seagate Technology Holdings plc Form 10-K FY2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001137789/000113778926000159/stx-20260703.htm

findings.claim: Seagate 10-K states production requires 'commodities and specialty materials, including certain rare earth elements, precious metals and specialized alloys, which may be subject to supply constraints or price volatility.'
findings.source: Seagate Technology Holdings plc Form 10-K FY2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001137789/000113778926000159/stx-20260703.htm

findings.claim: Seagate 10-K states: 'Changes in U.S. trade policy, including the imposition of sanctions or tariffs and the resulting consequences, may have a material and adverse impact on our business and results of operations.' It also says some products are subject to export control laws. The excerpt read has no explicit Taiwan-specific or Middle East/Iran language.
findings.source: Seagate Technology Holdings plc Form 10-K FY2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001137789/000113778926000159/stx-20260703.htm

findings.claim: Third-party supply-chain mapping (Gillware, estimate) says Seagate's Springtown, Northern Ireland wafer fab is long reported to produce on the order of one third of all HDD read/write heads globally. It names TDK (Japan) as the merchant head supplier.
findings.source: Gillware, 'The 2026 Hard Drive Supply Chain, Mapped', https://www.gillware.com/articles/hard-drive-supply-chain/

findings.claim: Third-party mapping (Gillware, estimate) says Japan's Nidec makes on the order of 80% of the world's HDD spindle motors. MinebeaMitsumi is a second source with Thailand manufacturing.
findings.source: Gillware, 'The 2026 Hard Drive Supply Chain, Mapped', https://www.gillware.com/articles/hard-drive-supply-chain/

findings.claim: Third-party mapping (Gillware) says China accounted for roughly 60% of world mined rare-earth supply and around 90% of refining of magnet-grade material used in HDD magnets. Japan produces the finished magnets.
findings.source: Gillware, 'The 2026 Hard Drive Supply Chain, Mapped', https://www.gillware.com/articles/hard-drive-supply-chain/

findings.claim: Third-party mapping (Gillware) says HDD controller silicon is designed by Broadcom and Marvell and manufactured by TSMC (Taiwan), with OSAT assembly in Taiwan and elsewhere in Asia. This is an industry-level map; it does not name Seagate's own controller vendors.
findings.source: Gillware, 'The 2026 Hard Drive Supply Chain, Mapped', https://www.gillware.com/articles/hard-drive-supply-chain/

findings.claim: Third-party mapping (Gillware) says HDD final assembly is centered in a Thailand cluster (primary), with Malaysia and China also involved. It says the 2011 Thailand floods eliminated up to half of global HDD manufacturing capacity within weeks and roughly doubled drive prices.
findings.source: Gillware, 'The 2026 Hard Drive Supply Chain, Mapped', https://www.gillware.com/articles/hard-drive-supply-chain/

geo_supply_chain.note: The 10-K as_of is the fiscal-year-end date (2026-07-03); the actual filing date was not verified. No percentage of Seagate output by site or country was found. The 10-K excerpt has no Taiwan-specific exposure language. Search summaries from low-quality aggregators (kavout, financialcontent) claimed the largest plant is in Wuxi, China. I did not confirm this against a primary source, so I excluded it. The Middle East/Iran risk line came from a search summary with an unclear source, so I also excluded it.
